artworks.title: Man at a Desk Wearing a Cross and Chain
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person with their upper body visible. The person is seated in a relaxed but upright position, slightly turned to their right, with their right hand holding a drawing instrument and resting on some papers or a surface. They have a slightly solemn facial expression with delicate features and straight, shoulder-length hair that frames their face and falls evenly on both sides. They are wearing a detailed garment that features elaborate designs and textures, including a ruffled collar and patterned sleeves. They are adorned with a chain necklace that has a cross pendant. The background of the image is dark and textured. The signature "Rembrandt/1641" is visible below the person in the portrait.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Boy in Profile
artworks.description: The image shows a drawn portrait of a person depicted from the waist up in profile. The individual has a youthful face, wavy hair, and is wearing a richly decorated jacket with an elaborate collar. The background is plain.

artworks.title: The Angel Departing from the Family of Tobias
artworks.description: This is a drawing of multiple figures gathered in contemplation or reverence. The central figure appears to be bowing or kneeling, possibly in prayer, among others who look on or surround this figure. There are elements of lighting and flowing fabrics, contributing to a sense of movement and focus. A figure is seen elevated towards the upper right. The drawing is detailed with line work typical of an etching style.

artworks.title: The Spanish Gypsy "Preciosa"
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals standing closely together from head to toe in a side-by-side position. The individual on the left has a shawl or hood over their head, partly covering their face. The person on the right has long hair and wears a rounded hat. Both individuals are portrayed wearing detailed clothing with patterns, including long skirts and cloaks or shawls. The person on the right is holding a walking stick or cane. The background features intricate line work, suggesting foliage or trees, with scratchy shading for texture. The setting appears to be outdoors, possibly in a garden or forest.

artworks.title: Three Oriental Figures (Jacob and Laban?)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three figures near an ornate structure. The figures are conversing, with one observing. A small dog is nearby. The ground is textured. The drawing uses detailed line work and shading for depth and detail in clothing and architecture. Trees or shrubs are suggested in the background with swirling lines and hatch marks.

artworks.title: Three Oriental Figures (Jacob and Laban?)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural scene with figures and a dog. There are three figures in elaborate robes, one bending slightly towards another. The backdrop includes architectural elements like an archway and columns framing a doorway. A small dog is standing between the figures, and there is an ornate canopy with foliage in the background. The lines are finely drawn, capturing details of the clothing and architecture, typical of classic etching techniques.

artworks.title: Christ Crucified between the Two Thieves: an Oval Plate
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crucifixion scene. The composition depicts three crucified figures at the top third. The scene is crowded with figures in varying emotional states at the base of the crosses. Detailed linework highlights expressions and garments. The background is filled with dense, etched lines implying an atmosphere. The drawing captures an intense moment with evocative chiaroscuro, reflecting Baroque influences.

artworks.title: Christ Crucified between the Two Thieves: an Oval Plate
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crucifixion scene. It depicts a central figure on a cross, flanked by two others on either side, also on crosses. There is a significant amount of detail in the figures' expressions and body language. A group of individuals are gathered at the base of the crosses, engaged in varied postures. The use of line work and shading creates depth and texture. The composition conveys a strong narrative, typical of religious imagery.

artworks.title: Old Man Shading His Eyes with His Hand
artworks.description: The image shows a partial depiction of a person's upper body, focusing on the head and shoulders. The individual is in a slightly angled position, with their head covered by a dark, textured hat. The person appears to be holding the brim of the hat with one hand. Their facial features are not distinctly visible, but there is a suggestion of a beard extending from their chin. The person is wearing a garment with a soft, flowing texture, possibly a fur collar or cloak draped around the shoulders. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Old Man Shading His Eyes with His Hand
artworks.description: The image is a partial sketch of a person's upper body. The figure is in a leaning position with one arm raised. A hand is holding a dark object, potentially a large hat, at chest level. The facial features are not detailed, and the figure has mid-length hair. The clothing is textured and appears to have a fur-like texture. No other objects or jewelry are present. The background is blank, highlighting the outlined figure.

artworks.title: Death Appearing to a Wedded Couple from an Open Grave
artworks.description: This is a drawing of elegantly dressed figures and a skeleton. Two figures in elaborate garments stand in the foreground, one holding a flower. They are near a seated skeleton near a darkened hearth. The skeleton is holding a small object, and there is an ornate frame behind the figures. The drawing is linear with precise details created through etching or engraving techniques.

artworks.title: A Peasant in a High Cap, Standing Leaning on a Stick
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly man standing with a walking stick, gesturing with his right hand. He has distinctive facial features, long hair, and a beard. He wears layered clothing, including a hat and a pouch hanging from his waist. The background is minimal, with details suggesting the ground and some flora in the corner. The painting is signed "Rembrandt 1639."

artworks.title: Joseph Telling His Dreams
artworks.description: The image shows a group of individuals with varying degrees of visibility, primarily focusing on their upper bodies. A seated older man wearing a fur-like detailed robe is at the center in a slightly turned pose, with hands resting on his lap and knees. He is looking towards the group. Nearby, other individuals stand or sit closely. Some wear turbans or hats. A diverse range of facial features is visible within the group, from bearded faces to curly hair. A woman is seated at the front, turning slightly towards one of the men and holding an open book, with her hair tied back. The individuals wear long, elaborate robes typical of historical attire. The background includes draped fabric and architectural elements like a doorway with an arch.

artworks.title: Man in a Broad-Brimmed Hat
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper half of a man's body, showing him from the chest up in a three-quarter view. He has a mustache, piercing eyes, and long, wavy hair. The man wears a large, wide-brimmed hat and a garment with a wide, ornate collar. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait in a Flat Cap and Embroidered Dress
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 9.2 x 6.2 cm (3 5/8 x 2 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image is a sketch showing the upper body of a person from the waist up. The person is in a slightly turned position, with their torso facing to one side but their head facing forward. The face has a wide nose and discernible eyebrows. The person has curly hair extending below their ears and is wearing a soft, loose cap. The clothing includes a garment with visible layers, possibly a shirt underneath with a tie or lacing detail at the collar. There are no visible jewelry or objects being held. The background consists of crossed hatch lines.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait in a Velvet Cap with Plume
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of a man, depicted from the waist up, seated and facing forward. He has a beard, curly, shoulder-length hair under a hat, and is wearing a fur-lined cloak over an elaborately embroidered garment with intricate details on the sleeves and front. He wears a soft, feathered hat with a wide brim. In his left hand, he holds what appears to be a cane or staff. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Sheet with Two Studies:  a Tree, and the Upper Part of a Head of the Artist Wearing a Velvet Cap
artworks.dimensions: sheet (sheet trimmed to platemark): 8 × 7.1 cm (3 1/8 × 2 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image displays intricate, swirling lines and textured shading to create an abstract scene. On the left side are fine lines resembling branches and leaves, with a small figure nearby. On the right side is a large, densely shaded form reminiscent of mountains or a rock formation. The elements come together to suggest landscapes and nature through imaginative shapes and line work.

artworks.title: Bust of an African Woman
artworks.description: The image displays a bust-length etching of a person in profile view. The individual is depicted seated, facing slightly right. The artwork details facial features like full lips, a prominent forehead, and eyes that are partially hidden. The person's hair is styled back with some falling behind, potentially secured with a braided or band-like accessory. They wear a garment with fabric folds and possible decorative elements at the neckline. The background is minimally detailed with shading or textural lines, emphasizing the subject.

artworks.title: Reclining Female Nude
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint and burin on Japan paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 8.3 x 16 cm (3 1/4 x 6 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a nude figure lying down, seen from the back with most of the body visible. The figure is positioned horizontally on a surface that resembles a bed or couch, with the head turned away. The hair is either closely cropped or not clearly defined due to shading. The artist used dense cross-hatching and shading to depict depth and contour, highlighting the figure's curves and musculature. The image does not show any facial features. The background is filled with dark cross-hatching, creating a dimly lit space with lighter areas suggesting fabric beneath the figure. There are no visible pieces of jewelry or objects. The overall composition is moody and textured, emphasizing light and shadow.

artworks.title: Reclining Female Nude
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint and burin on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an abstract form resembling a reclining figure. The composition uses hatched and cross-hatched lines to create the form lying upon a draped cloth or sheet. The texture is rich, with shadows to provide a sense of volume and depth. The background is dark, making the lighter areas of the form stand out in contrast. The focus is on the contours and the play of light across the shape, creating an evocative atmosphere.

artworks.title: The Goldsmith
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a workshop scene showing a sculpture and tools. The image features a craftsman carving a sculpture of a human form on a pedestal. In the background, there is a detailed fireplace or furnace. The drawing showcases precise line work and cross-hatching techniques to create texture and depth. Various tools are placed around the craftsman, indicating attention to detail and craft complexity. The image depicts a moment of concentration between an artisan and their craft.

artworks.title: The Image Seen by Nebuchadnezzar
artworks.dimensions:
image: 10 × 7 cm (3 15/16 × 2 3/4 in.)
sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 10.6 × 7 cm (4 3/16 × 2 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a classical statue. The image depicts an etched figure resembling a classical statue of a man adorned with cloth drapery. It stands on a pedestal marked with inscriptions like "Baboe," "Nabuc," "Grec," "Romani," and "Hetman." The background is shaded intensely to highlight the figure, a common technique in etchings, where the cross-hatching style adds depth. The artwork is signed with "Rembrandt" in the corner.

artworks.title: Jacob's Ladder
artworks.dimensions:
image: 10.6 × 7 cm (4 3/16 × 2 3/4 in.)
sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 11.5 × 7.5 cm (4 1/2 × 2 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows an etching with multiple figures. In the foreground, a person is reclined, partly covered in drapery, eyes closed. Above, another person is sitting, facing forward. On the right, a larger figure with wings is seen from the back, raising one arm. The image uses light and shadow effectively, with a dark background of more draped figures. There is a signature at the bottom left that reads "Rembrandt f. 1654."

artworks.title: Jacob's Ladder
artworks.dimensions:
image: 10.6 × 7 cm (4 3/16 × 2 3/4 in.)
sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 11.4 × 7.7 cm (4 1/2 × 3 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of multiple figures with varying visibility of their bodies. In the foreground is a reclined figure partially draped in cloth, with their head resting to one side. Above this figure, on the left side, there is an angelic figure with wings kneeling and leaning forward. Another figure is higher up on the right, turned away from the viewer and reaching upwards, showing the entire back and wings. The background features dark crosshatching and suggestive lines indicating light filtering through an unseen barrier, enhancing the dramatic lighting and shadowing in the composition.
